faq.title: CLEAR SOLUTIONS TO YOUR CONCERNS
faq.imageAlt: Project consultation with website wireframes and laptop

items.question: What is included in your branding service?
items.answer: Positioning, logo direction, colour palette, typography guidance and practical launch assets.

items.question: How long does it take to complete a website?
items.answer: Most small business sites take four to six weeks once content and decisions are ready.

items.question: Do you offer mobile-friendly design?
items.answer: Yes. Every layout is shaped for mobile, tablet and desktop before launch.

items.question: Can you redesign an existing website?
items.answer: Yes. We can refresh the structure, content, visuals and performance without losing what works.

items.question: Do you provide content development assistance?
items.answer: Yes. We write concise web copy, campaign messages and launch checklists.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing digital marketing campaigns?
items.answer: Yes. We can support SEO, landing pages, reporting and monthly campaign improvements.
